title: Team tab: every owner and member of a company can manage its team
text: Before, only one "main person" per company could add colleagues, change their powers or reset their password. Now every current owner or member of the company can, and nobody else: not an authorized representative, an accountant, a partner, a person who left, or an owner of a different company. A team login can never manage the team.
points: Sign in as a company owner or member: the Team tab is in the menu
Sign in as an authorized representative of the same company: no Team tab
stepsTitle: Who may manage a company's team

steps.name: Linked to this company now
steps.detail: A current link: not ended, not revoked, not expired. Another company's owner does not count.

steps.name: Owner or member
steps.detail: The link says owner or member. A representative, accountant or partner never does.

steps.name: On the members list
steps.detail: If the company has a members list, the person must be on it. Someone who left is off it.

steps.name: Can manage the team
steps.detail: Add colleagues, change their powers, switch them off, reset their password.
